## Setup

```{r setup}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```



## Task 1: Who owns the market

```{r task_1}
host_listings <- listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, city)

host_listings


# A1
a1_listings <- host_listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10) |> # confirming the bottom numbers are >= 10
  dplyr::arrange(n)

a1_listings # 200


# A2
a2 <- a1_listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarise(percent = dplyr::n() / sum(host_listings$city == "Chicago") * 100)

a2 # 3.39
  

```

## Task 2: Value for a family of four

```{r task_2}
family <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt", accommodates >= 4, number_of_reviews >= 10, review_scores_rating >= 4.8) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) 

family


family <- family |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(median_price = median(price_per_person), n = dplyr::n()) |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(median_price)

family # North Linden
```

## Task 3: What earns

```{r task_3}
earn <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

earn # 19619
```

```{r task_4}

  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) 

concentration
```

## Task 6: Demand by season

```{r task_6}
demand <- reviews |>
  dplyr::left_join(listings, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(total_reviews = sum(reviews))

demand

a8 <- demand |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

a8 # 2025-08

a9 <- a8 |> 
    dplyr::summarise(ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews))

a9 # 2.372235
```

## Task 7: Superhost Premium

```{r task_7}
premium <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

premium

superhosts <- premium |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_is_superhost == "t")

others <- premium |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_is_superhost == "f")

superhosts
others

premium_calc <- superhosts |> 
  dplyr::left_join(
    others,
    by = "city",
    suffix= c("_superhosts", "_others") # creates suffixes to separate the medians, otherwise it would just be .x and .y
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    premium =  median_price_superhosts - median_price_others
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(city, premium)

premium_calc # allows us to easily see the premiums across all three cities for part B questions
```

## Task 8: No rows in availability

```{r task_8}
missing_availability <- listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

missing_availability

a10 <- missing_availability |> 
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n())

a10 # 456

city_most_loses <- missing_availability |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n()) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))

city_most_loses # Columbus
```
